actual: Nightly run 27790281005 invoked DeepSeek V4 Pro with CodeGraph/Understand Anything context, but active discovery produced 34 candidates dominated by historical validation history production-gate quality debt and zero issue payload drafts. Improve the nightly LLM/discovery pipeline so it suppresses or separates historical P2/P3 quality-debt noise, prioritizes recent actionable runtime/CI/workflow defects, and can emit high-quality issue payload drafts in warning-only mode without root pollution or BUG JSON writes.
closure_requirements: Keep BUG JSON and GitHub Issue synchronized.
